data.title: Facial Liveness Failure Pattern — Iterative Deepfake Tuning
data.description: Detects repeated liveness check failures from the same device followed by eventual success — indicates iterative deepfake tuning where fraudsters adjust their deepfake parameters until they pass liveness detection. Normal users fail once (bad lighting) and succeed quickly; attackers show a pattern of 3+ failures with improving scores. Real-time face-swap applications and pre-recorded deepfake videos are used to defeat challenges requiring head turns, blinking, or phrase repetition. The iterative improvement pattern — each attempt scoring higher than the last — is a strong indicator of adversarial tuning against the liveness detection model.

detection.condition: selection_liveness_check AND filter_failure_pattern AND (count(liveness_result = "fail" WHERE same device_fingerprint within 24h) >= 3 AND liveness_result = "pass" within same 24h window) OR (liveness_score shows monotonic increase across 3+ consecutive attempts from same device_fingerprint)

enrichment_required.source: Aggregation — count of liveness failures per device_fingerprint in rolling 24h window
Derived — directional trend of liveness_score across consecutive attempts
Derived — interval between consecutive liveness check attempts
Liveness session analysis — unusual video compression artifacts indicating injection

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Iterative Deepfake Tuning Detection
// Detects repeated liveness failures followed by success from same device
event_type="LIVENESS_CHECK"
| groupBy(device_fingerprint, function=[
    count(liveness_result = "fail", as=failure_count),
    count(liveness_result = "pass", as=success_count),
    collect([liveness_score], limit=20) as score_history,
    min(liveness_timestamp) as first_attempt,
    max(liveness_timestamp) as last_attempt
  ])
| time_window_hours := (last_attempt - first_attempt) / 3600
| time_window_hours <= 24
| failure_count >= 3 AND success_count >= 1
| select([device_fingerprint, failure_count, success_count,
          score_history, first_attempt, last_attempt,
          time_window_hours])
| sort(failure_count, order=desc)

    max(liveness_timestamp) as last_attempt
    by device_fingerprint
| where (last_attempt - first_attempt) <= 86400
    AND failure_count >= 3 AND success_count >= 1

    by device_fingerprint
| dedup device_fingerprint
| table device_fingerprint, failure_count, success_count,

| sort - failure_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Iterative Deepfake Tuning Detection
-- Detects repeated liveness failures followed by success from same device
WITH liveness_stats AS (
  SELECT
    l.device_fingerprint,
    l.applicant_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.liveness_result = 'fail' THEN 1 END) AS failure_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.liveness_result = 'pass' THEN 1 END) AS success_count,
    MIN(l.liveness_timestamp) AS first_attempt,
    MAX(l.liveness_timestamp) AS last_attempt,
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, MIN(l.liveness_timestamp), MAX(l.liveness_timestamp)) AS time_window_hours,
    STRING_AGG(CAST(l.liveness_score AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY l.liveness_timestamp) AS score_history
  FROM liveness_checks l
  WHERE l.event_type = 'LIVENESS_CHECK'
    AND l.liveness_timestamp >= DATEADD(HOUR, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY l.device_fingerprint, l.applicant_id
)
SELECT
  device_fingerprint,
  applicant_id,
  failure_count,
  success_count,
  first_attempt,
  last_attempt,
  time_window_hours,
  score_history
FROM liveness_stats
WHERE failure_count >= 3
  AND success_count >= 1
  AND time_window_hours <= 24
ORDER BY failure_count DESC

Users unfamiliar with liveness check process who need several tries
Network connectivity issues causing liveness check session interruptions
